jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

We provide a platform that enables engineering teams to identify and resolve bugs that traditional testing approaches miss. Antithesis runs your entire system in a deterministic simulation, breaks it in every way imaginable, and hands you a root cause and a perfect reproduction — no flaky tests, no false positives, no "works on my machine". This allows engineering teams to debug faster and ship with greater confidence.

The rise of AI-generated code has made what we do more important than ever. Agents can write code faster than any human — but faster code isn't better code if it's buggy, stuck in review, or issues are slipping through the cracks undetected. The verification bottleneck is real and it's growing. This is exactly the problem Antithesis exists to solve. We've been quietly reinventing how the world thinks about software reliability, and we're just getting started.

We're well-funded, deeply technical, and building a platform that tackles one of the most complex yet important problems in modern software engineering. If that sounds like fun to you, keep reading.


About the Team

Engineers at Antithesis work across a wide range of domains, often developing their own tools along the way. They dig deep to understand how something really works -- but stay broad to ship features across the whole stack. The ideal Antithesis engineer is a generalist who loves to learn new things and will fearlessly hack on whatever is needed. The core requirements: you're smart, get things done, and a joy to work with.

We're looking for Senior, Staff, and Principal Engineers to build the future of autonomous testing. No matter your particular field of experience, if you've been ambitiously building complex software and think you could be a fit; drop us a note.


The Tech

Some of the tech and languages we use:

  • Nix. Lots of Nix. Nix for builds, Nix for infrastructure. Nix where you did not expect!

  • Rust for systems programming... and C/C++ where needed.

  • Typescript (and JS) on the front end.

  • All the other languages also: see our list of SDKs.


The Projects

We're looking for top-flight engineers to help us build:

  • A functional, reactive notebook

  • A streaming, analytic database

  • (Semi-) formally proven infrastructure

  • A custom, high-performance hypervisor

  • ...and other projects


The Culture

Our team is comprised of people with a variety of backgrounds: standard engineering degrees to philosophy degrees; big-tech background to scrappy startups. But we have at least one common skill: everyone on the team, including managers, is held to the same high standard of engineering competency. In addition, we value in-person work for its value in building trust and sharing knowledge and mentoring each other.

5 days a week in-office job in Vienna, VA

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug – you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

About the Role
We are looking for a driven and resilient individual with strong communication skills, an ability to learn technical concepts quickly, and ideally some experience in sales development or engaging with engineering leaders. As a Business Development Representative, you will play an important role within the sales organization, qualifying and generating leads, prospecting for new customers, driving event engagement, and developing/executing sales campaigns.

What You’ll Do

  • Research and identify high-potential companies within Antithesis’s ICP

  • Source and engage prospects through multi-channel outreach (LinkedIn, email, phone, events, X, etc)

  • Craft tailored, technical messaging that resonates with engineering leaders (CTOs, Directors of Engineering, Founding Engineers, etc)

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Antithesis’s platform and be able to validate a prospect company’s technical and business fit

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Antithesis’s platform and be able to articulate its value in both technical and business terms

  • Close collaboration with Account Executives to book and prepare qualified meetings, demos, proof-of-concept discussions

  • Close collaboration with Marketing and RevOps to refine campaigns and event-driven outreach

  • Stay current on industry trends in distributed systems, testing, and reliability to better engage technical prospects

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

  • Self-starter with developed interpersonal skills and organizational skills

  • Creative thinker and willing learner

  • Results oriented and prepared to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to understand deeply technical concepts

  • Team player

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Computer Science or Information Systems degree

  • SWE internship experience or coding experience

  • 1+ years of sales experience or sales certification

  • 1+ years cold calling experience

  • 1+ years Salesforce experience

  • 1+ years Google Workspaces products experience

Visa Sponsorship: We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without current or future sponsorship requirements.

Antithesis helps engineering teams find and fix bugs that traditional testing misses.

Our platform runs entire systems in a deterministic simulation, breaks them in every imaginable way, and provides engineers with root cause analysis and perfect reproduction. The result is faster debugging, more reliable software, and more confidence in what ships.

Antithesis is looking for Senior Account Executives with experience selling developer tools to customers in the finance industry.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will report either to a Regional Sales Leader or directly to the VP of Sales, depending on location.   • Partner with marketing to refine messaging and sales materials based on market feedback.

  • Focus on selling into the FinTech and Financial Services sector, with a long-term focus on selling across Wall Street accounts.

  • Have 5+ years of experience in full-cycle enterprise B2B SaaS sales, with direct experience selling developer tools or similarly technical products.

  • Demonstrate a consistent track record of exceeding quota.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Engineer - Bombadil
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

We've been quietly reinventing how the world thinks about software reliability, and we're just getting started! At Antithesis, we start at the foundations – we run entire software systems inside a deterministic simulation and break them in every way imaginable. Every issue then comes with a perfect reproduction, so you can identify root causes fast instead of spending days trying to recreate what went wrong.

The rise of AI-generated code has made this work more urgent than ever. Agents can write code faster than any human, but speed doesn't matter much when the output is buggy, stuck in review, or slipping through undetected. The verification bottleneck is real, it's growing, and solving it is one of the most consequential problems in software right now. That's what you'd be working on.

We're well-funded and deeply technical, the kind of place where the hardest problems get the most attention and the best ideas win regardless of who has them. If you want to do work that actually moves the needle on how reliable software can be, keep reading.

About the Role

We're looking for engineers in the Senior to Staff levels to build the future of autonomous testing. No matter your particular field of experience, if you've been ambitiously building complex software and think you could be a fit; drop us a note.

In this role you will be part of the team that maintains our open-source project Bombadil (https://github.com/antithesishq/bombadil). This includes working with the specification language and verifier, Chromium automation, advanced property-based testing, frontend development, and much more.

Must have for this role:

  • Proficient in Rust development

  • Experience with property-based testing or fuzzing

  • Comfortable with web technology (browsers, HTTP, HTML, Javascript, CSS)

Experience that would be a plus:

  • Chrome Devtools Protocol, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium

  • Formal specification languages (e.g. TLA+ or some LTL)

  • Implementing parsers, type systems, and interpreters

About Our Team

Our team spans CS degrees, philosophy, mathematics, and everything in between, or nothing formal at all. What everyone shares is a high bar for engineering quality. We work in-person because it's how we build trust and tackle hard problems together.

Location: This position is full time in the office in London, UK.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug – you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

About the Role

We’re looking for an unconventional thinker, a boredom fighter and an agent of chaos. You will be deploying the arsenal of tools and technologies from the Antithesis platform to find bugs and break our customers’ software. You will be able to articulate and convince future customers about the new paradigm of software testing and reliability brought by Antithesis.

What You'll Do

  • Execute in Proof-of-Concept (POC) engagements to help demonstrate Antithesis product value to new customers.

  • Participate in new customer onboarding activities.

  • Support the sales team with technical qualifications and consultations.

  • Lead customer workshops around Property-based-Testing (PBT) and other topics.

  • Find bugs and break open source software.

  • Thought leadership around testing complex systems.

  • Build, maintain and show product demos.

  • Guide customers and prospects on the Antithesis platform and testing methodologies.

Who You Are

  • 7+ years experience in technical pre-sales or consulting, guiding customers through evaluation, onboarding, and adoption of complex technical platforms. Big plus if you are doing this in the devtool space.

  • Highly technical, and more importantly technically curious.

  • Easily bored and needs new challenges.

  • Interested to learn and absorb new technologies.

  • Comfortable working in tight timelines and high pressure situations.

  • Great communicator - both written and verbal.

  • Good team player, able to work with small but highly skilled individuals.

  • Professional, but flexible - you can roll with the fast pace of a startup.

Good Skills and Experiences to have

  • Building, running automated tests (Integration tests, end-to-end testing)

  • Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes.

  • Object-oriented programming

  • Linux-based operating systems

  • Scripting languages (bash/shell, Python, Javascript)

  • Querying data (via SQL, NoSQL or other query engines)

This role will require some travel (client site, conferences, Antithesis HQ)

Visa Sponsorship: We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the applicable country without current or future sponsorship requirements.

jobs.title: Vice President of Customer Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

Antithesis helps engineering teams find and fix bugs that traditional testing misses.

Our platform runs entire systems in a deterministic simulation, breaks them in every imaginable way, and provides engineers with root cause analysis and perfect reproduction. The result is faster debugging, more reliable software, and more confidence in what ships.

As AI accelerates software development, the need for reliable verification is only increasing. Antithesis exists to solve that problem.

We are well-funded, deeply technical, and building a category-defining platform for modern software reliability.


About the Role

We are seeking a strategic Vice President of Customer Experience to lead and scale the operational foundation behind our customer experience organization. This leader will oversee the systems, processes, analytics, and cross-functional programs that support the full customer lifecycle across pre-sales, onboarding, customer success, support, renewals, and account management.

This role will partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership to ensure customers receive a seamless, high-quality experience while enabling the business to scale efficiently. The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic thinking, operational rigor, customer-centricity, and hands-on leadership experience within high-growth SaaS or technology environments.

You will play a critical role in driving customer retention, operational excellence, customer health visibility, forecasting accuracy, and scalable growth across the organization.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and optimize operational processes across the end-to-end customer lifecycle, including pre-sales handoffs, onboarding, implementation, adoption, support, renewals, and expansion.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Sales, and Account Management leadership to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

  • Build and scale customer operations infrastructure, including tooling, reporting, automation, forecasting, customer health scoring, segmentation, and lifecycle management programs.

  • Establish and track key customer metrics including retention, churn, NPS/CSAT, onboarding effectiveness, support performance, product adoption, and expansion opportunities.

  • Drive operational alignment between pre-sales and post-sales teams to improve continuity of the customer experience and reduce friction across the customer journey.

  • Develop scalable processes for customer escalations, renewal management, account transitions, customer communications, and executive business reviews.

  • Lead capacity planning, operational planning, and resource modeling efforts across customer-facing organizations.

  • Partner with executive leadership to develop customer growth strategies, identify operational risks, and improve organizational performance.

  • Evaluate and improve CRM, customer success, support, and analytics systems to ensure teams have accurate data and actionable insights.

  • Build, mentor, and develop high-performing operational teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.


What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Operations, Customer Success Operations, Account Management, Customer Experience, or related leadership roles within SaaS, cloud, or hyper-growth technology companies.

  • Proven experience overseeing or enabling customer-facing functions, including Customer Success, Technical Support, Account Management, and pre-sales operations.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise customer lifecycles and post-sales operating models.

  • Demonstrated success building scalable operational frameworks, systems, and processes in high-growth environments.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience leveraging data to drive operational improvements, customer retention, forecasting, and executive decision-making.

  • Experience building executive dashboards, operational reporting, customer health models, and business review processes.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and executive stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk, HubSpot, or similar customer operations tooling.

  • Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to balance strategic leadership and tactical execution


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS or highly technical products and customer environments.

  • Experience building or scaling global customer operations teams and programs.

  • Familiarity with AI-driven customer operations, workflow automation, or digital customer success strategies.

  • Experience with subscription-based revenue models, renewal forecasting, and expansion planning.

  • Background in scaling Series A through pre-IPO organizations.

  • Experience partnering closely with go-to-market, finance, and product organizations on strategic planning initiatives.


Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to shape and scale the operational foundation of a rapidly growing customer organization.

  • Highly visible leadership role with direct impact on customer experience, retention, and company growth.

  • Collaborative environment with strong partnership across executive leadership and cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to build scalable systems and processes from the ground up while driving meaningful business outcomes.

  • Ability to influence strategy, systems, process, and organizational design.

  • Fast-paced, high-growth environment with opportunities for ownership, innovation, and career growth.

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package.

  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.

We've been quietly reinventing how the world thinks about software reliability, and we're just getting started! At Antithesis, we start at the foundations – we run entire software systems inside a deterministic simulation and break them in every way imaginable. Agents can write code faster than any human, but speed doesn't matter much when the output is buggy, stuck in review, or slipping through undetected. The verification bottleneck is real, it's growing, and solving it is one of the most consequential problems in software right now. That's what you'd be working on.

We're well-funded and deeply technical, the kind of place where the hardest problems get the most attention and the best ideas win regardless of who has them. If you want to do work that actually moves the needle on how reliable software can be, keep reading.

About the Role

Pangolin is Antithesis's custom streaming analytics database — the backbone of how our customers interact with and make sense of their data. It's built around a native tree structure that scales to over a billion nodes, supports ACID transactions, and lets customers define arbitrarily complex queries through JavaScript UDFs. Under the hood: disaggregated storage and compute, Lambda-based processing, and S3-backed storage — a modern architecture built from scratch rather than inherited. It ingests and queries terabytes of customer data daily, and it does it fast. If you've ever read about a database limitation and thought that's a solvable problem, this is the place.

Pangolin is directly wired into the product — the notebook team builds on top of it, customers feel every improvement — so the work is real and the feedback loop is tight.

If you've thought deeply about how databases actually work and have the itch to build one that's better, this is the role.

  • Build and evolve Pangolin, our bespoke analytical database — a tree-native, streaming system handling terabytes of customer data daily.

  • Work closely with internal customers — including the notebook/UI team — to define priorities, shape the roadmap, and deliver features that make data exploration faster and more fluid.

  • Collaborate with the broader Infrastructure team on deployment, reliability, and scale.

  • Strong backend engineering background; you've worked on or alongside database systems and understand what makes them tick — the more depth, the better.

Bonus:

  • Experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale distributed backend systems; deep performance optimization experience; Linux internals; V8; AWS (S3 & Lambda).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

Antithesis helps engineering teams find and fix bugs that traditional testing misses.

Our platform runs entire systems in a deterministic simulation, breaks them in every imaginable way, and provides engineers with root cause analysis and perfect reproduction. The result is faster debugging, more reliable software, and more confidence in what ships.

As AI accelerates software development, the need for reliable verification is only increasing. Antithesis exists to solve that problem. We are well-funded, deeply technical, and building a category-defining platform for modern software reliability.

About the Senior Account Executive position

Antithesis is looking for Senior Account Executives with experience selling developer tools to highly technical customers, from senior engineers to C-level engineering leadership.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will report either to a Regional Sales Leader or directly to the VP of Sales, depending on location. You will work closely with customers, prospects, and internal teams to drive adoption of Antithesis’s technology. Occasional travel is expected, as is a willingness to contribute beyond a narrow role definition in a startup company.

  • Own and proactively manage your book of business with a high degree of accountability.

  • Engage senior engineers, engineering leaders, and executives in technical and business-focused sales conversations.

  • Help define and refine Antithesis’s customer qualification criteria and sales process as the company scales.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in product discussions with engineering and product teams.

  • Drive successful customer adoption by clearly articulating value, ROI, and integration considerations.

  • Mentor new Account Executives and contribute to a strong, collaborative sales culture.

  • Partner with marketing to refine messaging and sales materials based on market feedback.

Our ideal Senior Account Executive will:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, with direct experience selling developer tools or similarly technical products.

  • Be highly motivated, proactive, and comfortable owning pipeline creation and deal execution.

  • Have prior experience in Sales Engineering or technical product demonstrations (preferred).

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug – you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

About the Role

We are looking for a "player-coach" who can translate their experience and skillset to amplify a highly capable, fast-growing team. We are looking for candidates who are not only comfortable doing 1-on-1s with team members but able to lead by example with their technical execution and presales skills.

You will be leading a team based in our UK HQ2 office, combined with additional team members based in the APAC region. You will be responsible for maintaining critical business KPIs such as POC conversion rate and presales support volume for customers in the corresponding geographical region.

What You Do

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the team: onboarding, check-ins, performance reviews, vacation approvals, project (POC) assignments, and more.

  • Partner with our corporate recruiters and drive our recruiting effort for the EMEA/APAC region, and participate in the recruiting effort for other GTM functions.

  • Collaborate with regional sales leadership on presales support and POC execution.

  • Collaborate with global GTM functions such as marketing efforts (conferences) and enablement (training, workshops).

  • Help the team up-level their technical and communication skills.

  • Be a backstop for team members on customer engagements.

 

Who You Are

  • You maintain a strong technical foundation from previous related roles and industries.

  • You have a strong desire to mentor other team members and feel incredibly rewarded by the success of others.

  • You lead from the front, always taking the toughest challenges instead of delegating them to a team member.

  • You want to be "hands-on-keyboard" with POC execution and other technical activities.

  • You have experience working with Account Executives, sales leaders, and other GTM functions.

  • You retain technical curiosity and a willingness to learn new things and absorb new technologies.

  • You are comfortable working in tight timelines and high-pressure situations.

  • You are a great communicator, both written and verbal.

  • You are a good team player, able to work with a small but highly skilled team.

  • You are professional but flexible — you can roll with the fast pace of a startup.

Good Skills and Experience to Have

  • Software testing, reliability, and distributed systems

  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes

  • Object-oriented programming

  • Scripting languages (bash/shell, Python, JavaScript)

  • Querying data (via SQL, NoSQL, or other query engines)

 

This role will require some travel (client site, conferences, Antithesis HQ).

AI-generated code has made this work more urgent than ever. Agents write code faster than any human can, but faster code isn’t better code if it’s buggy, stuck in review, or quietly failing in production. The verification bottleneck is real, and it’s growing. That is precisely the problem Antithesis exists to solve. We’ve spent years quietly rethinking how the world approaches software reliability, and we’re just getting started.

We’re well-funded, deeply technical, and headquartered in Northern Virginia with satellite offices in London, San Francisco, and Singapore. Our team is in the office daily, which is how we take on hard problems together. If that sounds like fun to you, keep reading.


About the Role

Antithesis is looking for a Legal Counsel to serve as a key legal partner to the business as we grow. In this role, you will support vendor and customer contracting, lead the company’s privacy work, support our international subsidiaries, and build the internal policies that help the company scale responsibly.

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of law, product, and business strategy, and who likes covering a broad range of matters. You should be comfortable handling commercial and privacy issues, partnering with senior stakeholders, and balancing speed, judgment, and rigor in a fast-moving environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Vendor contracting: Review and negotiate vendor and procurement agreements, including software, cloud infrastructure, and professional services contracts, partnering with finance to build processes to keep purchasing moving

  • Customer contracts: Draft, review, and negotiate customer agreements, including SaaS agreements, order forms and related amendments, and advise sales and finance on deal structure, risk allocation, and negotiation strategy

  • Regulatory and Compliance: Lead the company’s privacy work including policies and review of vendor terms; advise on regulatory and compliance matters impacting the company

  • International subsidiaries: Support the company’s international subsidiaries on commercial, corporate, and local compliance matters, coordinating with outside counsel in the relevant jurisdictions

  • Internal policies: Draft, maintain, and roll out internal policies, and help employees understand and apply them in their day-to-day work

  • Create and refine templates, playbooks, and approval paths that bring consistency and speed to recurring contract and privacy issues

  • Provide business-focused legal advice on general corporate matters that enables thoughtful decision-making across the company


What Success Looks Like

  • Customer deals move at the pace the business needs, without the company taking on risk it didn’t understand or intend

  • Vendor contracts are turned around promptly, with privacy, security, and liability terms that protect the company

  • International subsidiaries stay in good standing and get responsive, practical legal support

  • Employees have clear, practical internal policies that they understand and follow

  • Stakeholders across the company treat Legal as a partner that helps them get to yes in a manner that protects the company, not a checkpoint to route around

What You Bring

  • J.D. and active bar membership in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction (see Virginia requirement below)

  • 5-10 combined years of experience at a top tier law firm or in-house.

  • Significant experience handling commercial transactions, with a strong mix of vendor-side and customer-facing contracting

  • Hands-on experience with privacy matters, such as privacy policies, data processing agreements, and vendor privacy review, along with working knowledge of frameworks like GDPR, UK GDPR, and U.S. state privacy laws

  • Experience supporting international subsidiaries or cross-border matters, including managing outside counsel abroad, is a plus

  • Experience drafting and implementing internal company policies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners

  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader business context


You May Be a Great Fit If

  • You’re willing to roll up your sleeves, take on new challenges and pitch in where needed

  • You can distinguish between theoretical risk and real business risk

  • You enjoy being a close partner to sales, finance, and operational teams

  • You are comfortable moving between a customer negotiation, a privacy question, and a subsidiary matter in the same day

  • You like designing repeatable legal processes, not just handling one-off matters

  • You thrive in roles that require both sound legal analysis and strong commercial instincts

Licensing Requirement

Candidates should be barred in Virginia or able to qualify as a Part I Corporate Counsel in Virginia.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis:

We've been quietly reinventing how the world thinks about software reliability, and we're just getting started! At Antithesis, we start at the foundations – we run entire software systems inside a deterministic simulation and break them in every way imaginable. Every issue then comes with a perfect reproduction, so you can identify root causes fast instead of spending days trying to recreate what went wrong.

 

The rise of AI-generated code has made this work more urgent than ever. Agents can write code faster than any human, but speed doesn't matter much when the output is buggy, stuck in review, or slipping through undetected. The verification bottleneck is real, it's growing, and solving it is one of the most consequential problems in software right now. That's what you'd be working on.

 

We're well-funded and deeply technical, the kind of place where the hardest problems get the most attention and the best ideas win regardless of who has them. If you want to do work that actually moves the needle on how reliable software can be, keep reading.

About the Role:

Antithesis is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our engineering team. This role primarily focuses on the Notebook - the reactive computing platform that all Antithesis UX is built on top of. As a Notebook Engineer, you will do a mix of deeply technical and heavily product-focused work.

What You’ll Do:

  • Make improvements to a reactive engine for executing Javascript (imagine Jupyter where everything auto recalcs).

  • Own a new feature, from the front end to the data layer. This includes adding features as needed to our custom database (or proxy, or API server) to get the feature done.

  • Create Property Based Tests and Antithesis workloads to test the things you create.

  • Work with our product managers to design and scope features.

  • Develop build and deployment logic in Nix.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience working with complex customer facing-products.

  • Be very comfortable with Typescript, and ready to pick up a bit of Rust work.

  • Have strong technical skills and a solid programming background in algorithms and data structures.

  • Experience building static and dynamic websites

  • Understanding of how the internet and browsers work

  • (bonus) experience with Nix

  • (bonus) have ideas about leveraging AI effectively

  • (bonus) a prior history with PBT

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Antithesis

Antithesis helps engineering teams find and fix bugs that traditional testing misses.

Our platform runs entire systems in deterministic simulation, exploring how they can fail, and gives engineers the root cause analysis and perfect reproduction they need in order to fix those failures.

We’re well-funded, deeply technical, and building a new approach to software verification for the AI era.


About the Senior Account Executive Position

Antithesis is looking for a Senior Account Executive in the Pacific Northwest region to help build and scale our enterprise sales organization. This role is best suited for someone who has experience selling technical products to software engineering organizations and is comfortable engaging everyone from hands-on engineers to CTOs and other executive stakeholders.

Antithesis is pioneering a new approach to software testing and finding bugs, so this is not a role where you will inherit a mature market, established messaging, or a defined sales process. You will be responsible for developing new business, navigating complex technical evaluations, and helping customers understand how Antithesis can address problems they may not yet know how to solve.

You will own the sales process from initial engagement through close, working closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and company leadership. As an early member of our GTM organization, you will also have an opportunity to shape how we sell, qualify, forecast, and grow our customer base.

As a Senior Account Executive at Antithesis, you will:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through technical evaluation, negotiation, and close.

  • Develop and maintain a sales pipeline within a defined territory, across technical ICPs and executive stakeholders, including but not limited to software engineers, engineering managers, architects, VPs of Engineering, CTOs, and other business leaders.

  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineers and Business Development Reps to uncover customer needs and technical environments, guiding further technical evaluations, and developing compelling demonstrations and proofs-of-concept.

  • Develop and maintain accurate forecasts and pipeline visibility, with disciplined ownership of deal progression and next steps.

  • Provide customer and market feedback to Product, Engineering, Marketing, and GTM leadership to help shape product direction, positioning, messaging, and our sales motion.

  • Help refine our sales motions, qualification criteria, discovery process, and best practices as the organization scales.

  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-accountability sales culture and help onboard and mentor other members of the GTM team as the organization grows.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B enterprise software sales, preferably selling developer tools, reliability, infrastructure, observability, cloud, testing, or another technically complex product with technical ICPs.

  • Experience selling to software engineering organizations and engaging technical buyers throughout the sales process.

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with an ability to uncover customer problems rather than simply present product capabilities.

  • A track record of owning and closing complex enterprise opportunities with multiple stakeholders and meaningful technical evaluation requirements.

  • Experience creating pipeline through a combination of BDR partnership, outbound prospecting, field marketing, and/or strategic planning.

  • The ability to move comfortably between technical and business conversations, adapting your message for engineers, engineering leaders, and executives.

  • Comfort operating in an early-stage or rapidly evolving company where processes, messaging, territories, and responsibilities are still being developed.

  • A high degree of ownership, sound judgment, and willingness to take initiative without waiting for a fully defined playbook.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Willingness to travel and attend customer meetings, industry conferences, regional events, meetups, and team activities.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience in a Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or similarly technical customer-facing role.

  • The technical curiosity to understand how customers build, deploy, test, and operate software, and to engage credibly in conversations with technical audiences.

  • Experience selling an emerging or category-creating product where customer education and market development are part of the sales process.

  • Experience at an early-stage startup where you helped establish or refine the sales motion rather than operating solely within an established playbook.

  • Additional language skills beyond English.

jobs.title: Manager/Lead, Deal Desk
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Manager / Lead, Deal Desk

About the role

As our first Deal Desk hire, you will build and run the function from the ground up.

You will report into the Revenue Operations function and partner with Sales, Finance and Legal to structure complex deals, accelerate approvals, improve pricing discipline and make it easier for customers to buy from Antithesis.

This is a high-trust, highly autonomous role. We are looking for someone who can manage competing priorities, operate with incomplete information and drive issues to resolution without waiting for direction.

A core responsibility is protecting the long-term economics of the business. You will help us close strong deals without creating pricing precedent or commercial terms that unnecessarily erode future contract value or margin.

What you'll do

  • Own Deal Desk day to day, including deal structuring, reviews, approvals and escalations.

  • Partner with Account Executives on usage commitments, ramps, multi-year terms, payment terms, renewals, expansions and co-term structures.

  • Model ACV, TCV, discounting, usage economics and margin and recommend commercially sound structures.

  • Protect long-term contract value and margin by evaluating the downstream impact of pricing, discounts and non-standard terms.

  • Identify pricing inconsistencies, approval bottlenecks, process gaps and recurring deal friction.

  • Leverage AI to be a force multiplier - find efficiencies and strategic gains in the process.

  • Own and optimize DealHub workflows, approvals, quote templates and CRM integration.

  • Build and enforce pricing guides, playbooks and guardrails that enable reps to self-serve standard deals.

  • Track deal cycle time, approval turnaround, discounting, exceptions and SLA performance and use those insights to improve the process.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Learn our product, pricing and sales motion.

  • Map the quote-to-cash process and identify major friction points.

  • Begin independently supporting live deals.

First 90 days

  • Become the primary Deal Desk partner for non-standard deals.

  • Establish a clear intake process, approval matrix and SLA framework.

  • Publish pricing and deal-structure guidance.

  • Improve DealHub workflows and simplify the sales process.

First 12 months

  • Reduce deal cycle time and approval turnaround.

  • Improve pricing discipline and deal quality.

  • Increase rep self-service on standard deals.

  • Build a scalable Deal Desk operating model.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A or a similar role in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • Experience structuring complex enterprise deals, including usage-based pricing, multi-year agreements, co-term renewals and non-standard commercial terms.

  • Experience with DealHub or another CPQ platform, including approvals, quoting workflows and process optimization.

  • Experience with Ironclad or other CLM tools

  • Strong financial modeling skills and working knowledge of SaaS metrics and ASC 606.

  • Familiarity with enterprise contracting, including payment terms, renewals, co-terming and commercial exceptions.

  • Strong commercial judgment. You understand that closing the deal matters, but so do its long-term economics and precedent.

  • High trust and ownership. You can handle sensitive pricing and commercial decisions, prioritize independently and know when to escalate.

  • High EQ with persistence. You can challenge assumptions, push back when needed and keep work moving without damaging relationships.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can form a point of view, make recommendations with incomplete information and drive toward resolution.

Desired experience

  • Experience supporting usage-based or infrastructure software businesses.

  • Experience building or improving Deal Desk processes in a scaling organization.

  • Experience with marketplace transactions, including AWS Marketplace, is a plus.

  • Experience as an early Deal Desk or RevOps hire at a high-growth startup is a plus.

Why join

  • Build from zero. Define what Deal Desk becomes at Antithesis.

  • High impact. Directly influence how we price, structure and close business.

  • High trust and autonomy. Own the function and drive improvements.

  • Shape how we scale. Build the processes and guardrails that let the business move faster without sacrificing commercial discipline.

This role is fully onsite in Vienna, VA.

Antithesis is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The role

Antithesis is looking for a Contracts Manager to help us move quickly and thoughtfully as we scale. In this role, you will own day-to-day contract review and negotiation across a wide range of commercial matters, with a particular focus on helping internal teams close business efficiently while managing legal and operational risk.

This is a practical, high-judgment role for someone who is comfortable working directly with cross-functional partners, translating legal issues into clear business guidance, and improving the systems and processes that support contract review at scale.

What you'll do

  • Review, draft, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including NDAs, vendor agreements, customer-facing agreements, and other operational contracts

  • Partner closely with sales, finance, and leadership teams to provide clear, actionable guidance during contract review

  • Identify legal, business, and operational risks in proposed agreements and recommend practical paths forward

  • Support all aspects of the Legal department as needed in a dynamic, rapidly growing organization.

  • Help maintain and improve contract templates, fallback language, playbooks, and internal review processes

  • Support contract intake and triage so requests are routed appropriately and handled efficiently

  • Advise internal stakeholders on approval requirements, escalation points, and contracting best practices

  • Track recurring issues in negotiations and help turn them into better standards, tools, and workflows

  • Contribute to the buildout of a legal function that is trusted, responsive, and business-minded

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5+ years of commercial transactions experience, preferably in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong judgment about risk, materiality, and when to escalate

  • Ability to explain contract issues in plain English to non-lawyers

  • Experience with Ironclad is a plus

  • Excellent drafting, issue-spotting, and negotiation skills

  • A highly organized working style and the ability to manage multiple matters at once

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can shift quickly

  • A service-oriented mindset and a bias toward solving problems, not just identifying them

You may be a great fit if

  • You like building structure where there is ambiguity

  • You care about helping teams move fast without cutting corners

  • You are equally comfortable redlining agreements and improving the process behind them

  • You know how to be precise without being rigid

  • You have a strong instinct for when a contract issue is routine, when it is strategic, and when it needs escalation

This role is fully onsite in Vienna, VA.
